payload: Send 20 requests within 1000ms window to /api/auth/login or sensitive endpoint
purpose: Verify if endpoint enforces burst rate limiting to thwart automated credential stuffing or brute force.
expected_secure_behavior: Server returns HTTP 429 Too Many Requests after threshold is reached with Retry-After header.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Server processes all 20 requests consecutively without throttling.
remediation: Apply express-rate-limit middleware or Redis-backed sliding window rate limiter.

purpose: Test if rate limiter relies on spoofable client-supplied X-Forwarded-For header.
expected_secure_behavior: Server extracts IP from trusted reverse proxy connection (e.g. app.set('trust proxy', 1)) or session key.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Rate limiter is bypassed by simply rotating X-Forwarded-For IP values.
remediation: Configure express 'trust proxy' correctly to trust only known upstream proxy hops, or key by account/token.
